title: Corporate Secretary-Associate Director
jobDescription: Job Title – Company Secretary-Associate Director Management Level: 05-Associate Director Location: Mumbai Must have skills: Strong knowledge of Company Law and FEMA regulations Job Summary: Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, Accenture offers Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services and Accenture Song—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Accenture India has operations in 16 cities across India and have ~ 350k employees spread across these locations. We are looking for a qualified member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), with a minimum of 20 years of experience for the position of Company Secretary of the Accenture India legal entity, to lead the Corporate Secretarial team. Reporting will be to the Managing Director, Legal. Corporate Secretarial team ensures compliance with company law matters and compliances related to V & As, entity integrations and the like. Internal clients range from HR, Finance, Controllership, Taxation, Recruitment, Real Estate, Workplace, Global Asset Protection (GAP), Marketing and Communication (Marcom), Infrastructure Services, and Government Relations. Roles & Responsibilities: This role offers an opportunity to be at the forefront of corporate governance in one of the world's leading organizations. Far beyond traditional secretarial and compliance responsibilities, the candidate will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with senior leadership to drive effective governance across a complex global organization. What makes this role unique? Be a trusted advisor to senior leaders and MD-level stakeholders Work in a dynamic, multi-jurisdictional, multi-entity environment Partner across functions to influence key organizational decisions Contribute to emerging governance priorities, including AI and evolving business models High-impact role with significant ownership and visibility Key Responsibilities This role is broad and involves leading the company law compliance, mergers and other corporate actions, FEMA compliance and others, including, but not limited to the following. Strong and thorough knowledge of Company Law including CSR Sound knowledge of FEMA related to foreign remittances, ODI and FLA compliances Provide strategic counsel to a seasoned Board by advising on governance best practices, company law compliance, board composition, and enterprise risk management Work closely with finance, internal audit, tax, HR and legal teams on all matters related to Accenture India governance matters and related regulatory compliance, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives and stakeholder expectations Assess impact of changes in law and regulatory environment, impacting the Company Liaise with external legal counsel and regulatory advisors for effectively managing compliance Undertake and drive process and system improvements Guidance during due diligence and structuring decisions related to acquisitions Strong knowledge and experience on rectification of FEMA non-compliances related to share allotments and transfers to non-residents Ensuring compliance related to all statutory meetings such as Board / Committee meetings, General meetings, as may be required by law, within prescribed timelines. Ensure that Board procedures and internal policy approvals are diligently adhered to. Guidance on drafting Directors reports, CSR reports, loan agreements Ensure compliance of all regulatory filings with MCA / RBI including filings for adhoc events, as may be necessary. Ensure that secretarial audit is conducted as per prescribed timelines, in compliance with Secretarial standards. Additional Information: Candidate has to be a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. Law degree will be an added advantage. Minimum 20 years of relevant work experience in a Private Company or Practicing CS firm or a law firm handling corporate law matters. title: Contract Associate Manager
jobDescription: Contract Management is part of our Legal and Commercial Services. Our professionals bring innovative ideas to commercial reality with a focus on maximizing value for all parties through a deep understanding of legal, business and commercial risks. We work alongside Accenture sales and delivery teams throughout the entire contract lifecycle to provide high quality advice and support for negotiation, drafting and ongoing management of client contracts. We apply commercial and contractual expertise to lead the delivery of legal & commercial outcomes for our priority engagements and portfolios, including: · Sales growth: expanding the footprint of our agreements and supporting new business; · Revenue protection: delivering on our contractual commitments; · Margin improvement: effectively managing commercial levers, risks and issues; and · Compliance with contract obligations and Accenture policy. Act, and continuously evolve as, a knowledgeable and relevant advisor on legal and commercial risks associated with transactions. title: Security Operations Center Operator
jobDescription: Job Summary: The SOC Operator will be responsible for assessing, analyzing, and responding to incidents related to safety and security for the APAC region. The role requires daily use of tools/systems (e.g., access control, video management, risk feeds) to detect the impact to Accenture’s people, products, property, or brand image and alert the appropriate response stakeholders. Specifically, incidents may range from extreme weather conditions, political instability, crime, terror, civil unrest, and other personnel issues. In addition, the Operator will be responsible for customer service tasks to provide critical information and assistance to travelers, static employees, and potentially third parties. This role will be based in Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra and reports to the SOC Shift Supervisor. Roles & Responsibilities: Monitor and operate security systems including access control and CCTV, along with environmental monitoring and mass notification systems. Respond quickly and initiate action related to alarms, phone calls, and environmental monitoring and alerting systems Notify, assist, and direct external emergency personnel and internal resources as necessary Dispatch security officers or law enforcement personnel for alarm response, calls for service, and emergency situations Execute protocols and communicate at all levels across the APAC region to employees, site security leads, safety & security staff, or contracted officers as needed Manage information flows to and from an incident Maintain operational logs, conduct daily shift checklists, handover reports, and incident reports Ensure all forms of communication, such as e-mails, phone conversations, and client interactions, are conducted in a courteous and professional manner, confidentially, and documented appropriately Coordinate with Accenture’s Corporate Security regional leads on incident detection and management Coordinate with Accenture’s Corporate executive protection leads on incident detection and management Ensure that complete and accurate information is entered into the incident management system Utilize and execute protocols and standard operating procedures to effectively manage global incidents. Monitor travel safety and security of the company's staff Maintain situational awareness of current global current events. Monitor and respond to global alerts and events affecting company facilities and employees providing immediate information and assistance as needed Initiate mass communication notifications as required Notify leadership of events affecting business operations and employees Ensure proper handling of highly confidential information. title: Geographic Legal Counsel Specialist Data Privacy
jobDescription: Role Summary – To provide comprehensive legal support to internal teams, which includes support on Accenture policies and processes, compliance, legal research and legal judgements, using various tools and methodologies. Focus on compliance with Data Privacy laws and internal policies and risk mitigation. Specific Responsibilities aligned to Role Act as local Data Privacy specialist for different geographies and/or teams, understanding local laws and global company policies to ensure compliance. Act as local Data Privacy legal advisor and point of contact for cross legal areas reviews related to internal data processing e.g. platforms, applications, tools and systems. Obtain a deep understanding of the program/project from a technical perspective to be able to provide relevant Data Privacy legal advice. Identify potential areas of legal/compliance vulnerability and risk, develop/implement corrective action plans for resolution of problematic issues and provide guidance on how to avoid or deal with such issues from a general legal perspective. Collaborate and consult with all legal areas (from a global and local perspective) to ensure key legal/ compliance issues are identified and sent to appropriate channels for investigation and review. Provide legal support to Accenture Corporate Functions and other areas on local & global legal matters. Provide legal advice and guidance and respond to inquiries made by various internal teams such as Workplace Solutions, Marketing & Communication, HR, Corporate Citizenship, CIO, IT and business teams, among others, on their daily operation. title: Security Operations Center Incident Manager
jobDescription: The Security Operations Center (SOC) Manager serves as the deputy to the SOC Senior Manager and provides operational and strategic leadership within Accenture’s Global Security Operations Centers organization. This role is responsible for ensuring performance and consistency across the three core ASOC pillars: Threat Monitoring, Building Monitoring and Alarms, and ASOC Calls. The SOC Manager also serves as the primary Travel Security Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the ASOC, helping ensure Accenture travelers in high-risk destinations are supported. This position is based in Pune, India and reports directly to the SOC Senior Manager. Key Responsibilities: Lead response efforts for complex, high-impact incidents affecting Accenture employees, travelers, facilities, and global business operations to include notify, assist and direct external emergency personnel and internal resources as necessary. Manage threat monitoring involving extreme weather, geopolitical instability, crime, terrorism, civil unrest, medical emergencies, and travel-related disruptions. Ensure threat monitoring is assessed, escalated, coordinated, and communicated in alignment with the GP&S Escalation Model and SOC Standard Operating Procedures. Liaise with SOC stakeholders such as Regional Protective Services, Executive Protection/Events, and Intelligence to ensure threat monitoring triggers meet their organizational needs. Establish and enforce standards for high-quality writing across ASOC products. Maintain situational awareness of high-risk travel regions and ensure delivery of timely alerts and advisories to traveling employees and stakeholders, including Mobility and Human Resources. Provide operational oversight and decision-making during active incidents to ensure timely, accurate, and effective outcomes. Act as a trusted operational partner to GP&S stakeholders and regional security leadership. Responsible for training SOC personnel to ensure competency and readiness when supporting GP&S in incident and incident response activities. Conduct thorough After-Action Reviews (AARs) after an incident and document areas of improvement and track SOC action items through completion. Conduct regular SOP reviews and updates to ensure policies and instructions provide up-to-date and clear guidance to enable an efficient response by SOC personnel. Job Requirements: Ability to work outside of business hours on short notice during critical events to include, nights, weekends, and or holidays. Bachelor’s degree Minimum of 5 years of work experience in military, law enforcement, intelligence, or corporate security environments supporting security incident monitoring, communications, and response. Preferred Skills Bias for action and strong attention to detail. Strong writing skills and experience preparing communications to be shared with senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing high stress and impactful incidents. Experienced and independent communicator, both verbal and written. Experience with emergency response protocols and processes. Bilingual (languages in addition to English). Experience with threat monitoring and emergency communication tools such as Factal, SamDesk, Everbridge, ISOS, etc. Experience with CCure, Genetec or Sureview. Proficient in Microsoft Windows and Office Suite. Apply a cross-enterprise perspective spanning business and technology stakeholders, navigating ambiguity to pursue a consistent transformation vision. Maintain strong internal and client relationships through consistent delivery, proactive communication, and executive-level presence. Experience designing and embedding program governance structures — decision cadences, escalation models, accountability frameworks, and standardized ways of working. Demonstrated ability to coach senior leaders on transformation management principles — enabling effective decision-making, alignment, and disciplined execution across workstreams. Skill in embedding transparency, accountability, and a culture of continuous improvement — ensuring governance is actively practiced, not just documented. Track record of building transformation playbooks, toolkits, and SOPs — and facilitating structured health and risk reviews to identify execution gaps and co-create corrective actions. Prior exposure using AI to manage large transformation programs — AI-driven dashboards, intelligent tracking, and analytics to enhance program visibility and value outcomes. Facilitation skills across Design Thinking, Value Stream Mapping, and transformation roadmap sessions; trusted advisor capability to navigate ambiguity and resolve cross-functional tensions. Experience using structured diagnostics to identify program execution risks and recommend governance remediation actions. Demonstrated ability to identify, deploy, and articulate Agentic AI use cases within ongoing programs. Familiarity with leading AI agent frameworks and LLM-powered workflow automation tools. title: Acquisitions Legal Counsel Associate Manager
jobDescription: Global Legal Network is a group of professionals operating globally from 12 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services - focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centers of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. Ventures & Acquisitions (V&A) assists in the legal aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures and strategic investment transactions, including due diligence, drafting, reviewing, and negotiating acquisitions documents, the target’s agreements and other documentation, advises on legal risks and mitigation alternatives associated with the transactions. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: We are an equal opportunity employer. We have an unwavering commitment to equality for all. Together, we are acting, we are leading, and we will drive change across the globe. JOB SUMMARY: Complexity: Requires analysis and solving of moderately complex problems. Typically creates new solutions, leveraging and, where needed, adapting existing methods and procedures. Requires understanding of the strategic direction set by senior management as it relates to team goals. Primary upward interaction is with direct supervisor or team leads. Generally, interacts with peers and/or management levels at a client and/or within Accenture. Authority:  Requires minimal guidance when determining methods and procedures on new assignments. Impact or Decision:  Decisions often impact the team in which they reside and occasionally impact other teams. Scope:  Manages medium-small sized teams and/or work efforts (if in an individual contributor role) at a client or within Accenture. Responsibly provide support to key Accenture M&A stakeholders including M&A deal attorney, Procurement Plus V&A, Contracting, Legal Integration teams and other Legal teams in different geographies. Document, review and draft the terms and conditions of different types of agreements and other documents relating to various target/acquired companies in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and stakeholders’ requirements. Collaborate and coordinate with Accenture’s M&A deal attorney, Legal Integration Managers and Procurement Plus V&A Leads on the review of data room materials, in particular executed client, alliance and supplier agreements of the target companies. Train the team members and develop checklists and process documents for pre- and post-acquisition legal support. Directly liaising with internal stakeholders and deal teams on various legal and commercial issues. Maintain contract / subcontract compliance in line with company policies and procedures and ensures issues are resolved. Responsibly works at smaller engagements and/or works within team at a large, complex engagement. QUALIFICATIONS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS: Minimum of 8 years of experience at law firm and/or as in-house counsel and experience in coordinating teamwork (or as individual contributor). Experience in M&A practice with strong knowledge of M&A transactions, due diligence exercises, general corporate business practices, commercial contracting regulations, subcontracting practices and ability to apply skills creatively to diverse stakeholder needs. Demonstrates ability to consistently and responsibly undertake contract drafting to a reasonable standard. Strong time-management, prioritization, organizational, problem solving skills. Displays a high level of responsiveness and follows through on commitments. Detail-oriented, sound judgement, organized, and flexible. Demonstrates a specialized subject-matter experience. title: Contract Associate - NRR 4542
jobDescription: Accenture is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Accenture will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Accenture encourages applicants of all ages. Global Legal Network (GLN) is a group of professionals operating globally from 10 countries. It provides a broad spectrum of differentiated services - focused on delivering value and innovation. We partner with Legal teams across Accenture to build efficiencies and centres of excellence related to Legal services; and through our size, geographic spread and language diversity, the Global Legal Network is able to drive quality, agility and speed in our services, aligned to Accenture’s relentless focus on maximum efficiency and operational effectiveness. CORE and Global Services (CGS) is a group of legal professionals working and supporting different legal areas such as Compliance, Regulatory Offerings, Ethics, Procurement, Corporate Matters and the Services Areas aligned with the new offerings and technologies such as Strategy & Consulting, Interactive, Technology, Security and Operations. Procurement, NDA and Colocation & Software License Management- Support DCN Legal team within CGS functional area in India: Procurement, NDA and Colocation Role Summary- Performing the due diligence, documenting and reviewing terms and conditions and negotiating through procurement contracts/sub-contracts, proposals, agreements, statements of work, NDAs and other documents relating to various operating groups; and assist in performing due diligence to ensure process compliance and risk mitigation in accordance with company policies and procedures, applicable laws, and customer requirements. License Management Role Summary – To support the Legal Services team in reviewing the End User License Agreement/License terms of various commercial and non-commercial software requested for installation within India Delivery Centre and to review, evaluate and recommend whether Accenture has right to reuse/redistribute assets such as software, tools, applications developed by Accenture, based on related third-party licenses and associated IP rights, and to define the scope and limits of Accenture's use and reuse of such assets. Management Level Description Complexity: Requires solving of routine problems, largely through precedent and referral to general guidelines. Interaction is within own team and direct supervisor. Authority: Requires detailed to moderate level of instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instruction on new assignments. Impact or Decision Impact: Decisions impact own work. Scope: Individual contributor as a part of a team, with a predetermined, focused scope of work. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Generic Responsibilities Understand the CORE areas Understand relevant company policies Understand company's service offerings in context of the support area Understand company's approval processes and ensures that all stakeholders are timely engaged and informed on the relevant process Assist team in drafting checklists, process documents and generic tracking reports Directly liaising with internal stakeholders on various issues Recognize issues and provide timely escalation to Team Lead or appropriate stakeholders Understand and suggest process improvements in the support area Provide on the job training and support to the new joiners of the team Support implementation of new initiatives in the support area or within Legal/GLN Build credible and effective relationships within GLN team Support tech team in development of new tech tool or enhancement of existing ones Manage SharePoint and communication records. Specific Responsibilities aligned to Role Demonstrate review skills with minimal dependency on supervisor inputs. Reviewing of contracts/sub - contracts, proposals, agreements and other documents relevant to CORE functional area strictly on need basis for process compliance; Provide assistance in negotiating the access related documentation and other contracts in collaboration with the account CM or legal counsel, ensuring proper risk mitigation before permitting colocation arrangement for Accenture client and client’s third party End to end responsibility to conduct compliance and risk analysis - for commercial software used in project solutions; for usage of software, tools, applications developed by Accenture; for reusable technical assets (applications) for global licensing. Review, evaluate and recommend whether Accenture has right to reuse/redistribute software, tools, applications developed by Accenture, based on related third-party licenses and associated IP rights, and to define the scope and limits of Accenture's use and reuse of such assets. Review, evaluate and recommend, the rights and restrictions involved in a software license agreement, end user license agreement for both commercial and non-commercial software and analyze the associated risks in using the software on Accenture owned devices in accordance with the users intended scope of usage. Directly liaising with internal stakeholders and deal teams on various legal and commercial software licensing aspects. Understand process improvements in CORE support area and assist team in drafting checklists and process documents. Support implementation of new initiatives in License Management area or within Legal Services (in addition to allocated role). Understand company's service offerings in context of License Management area and ensure compliance with applicable company policies and procedure and regulatory environment. Independent handling of the requestors, understanding the business requirements and advising on the process compliance. Collaborating with internal stakeholders regularly for process improvement and tracking the requests and generating reports quarterly and annually for the senior management. Maintain process compliance in line with company policies and procedures and ensure issues are resolved and escalate to line manager with issues. EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law. Certifications and Membership: Compliance related global professional certification considered a plus. title: Security Operations Center Operator
